st: Spermidine, purple potatoes and other superfoods?

sec.t: ff.99.1 What to eat to stop ageing?
sec.p: In a week I turn 30. Perfect timing, then (pea-fectly, you might say, and a legume is no coincidence) for Michael Greger's new book on how to slow down ageing. This is a man who starts his breakfast with a shot of spices in potato starch.
Let's start with something “spicy”: spermidine can extend life by almost 6 years.

sec.t: ff.99.3 Purple potatoes: the ultimate superfood?
sec.p: Instead of €100-a-jar supplements, Michael suggests plants, fruit and legumes. In short, another fine example of simplicity.

sec.t: ff.99.4 The microbiome in your poop
sec.p: Gut wellbeing and fibre: a recurring theme on futuro fortissimo, 🦠ff.92.2 One more organ: the microbiome, 🎼 ff.17 Sport (and the people who poop it).
